actions.description: Validate commit message format against Conventional Commits standard

config.label: Block secrets in staged files (API keys, tokens, passwords)

actions.action: git diff --name-only --cached --diff-filter=d | xargs -r -I {} sh -c 'case "{}" in *.sh) [ "$(stat -c %a "{}")" != "755" ] && chmod 755 "{}" && git add "{}" && echo "Fixed: {} -> 755" ;; *.md|*.json|*.js|*.cjs|*.ts|*.yaml|*.yml|*.php|*.neon|*.xml|.prettier*|.npm*|.markdown*) [ "$(stat -c %a "{}")" = "600" ] || [ "$(stat -c %a "{}")" = "660" ] && chmod 644 "{}" && git add "{}" && echo "Fixed: {} -> 644" ;; esac' || true
actions.description: Fix file permissions on staged files (scripts: 755, configs: 644)

Fix code style on staged Node.js files (TS/JS, JSON, MD) via Prettier, ESLint, Markdownlint (auto-fix and re-stage). Uses --no-stash and --no-hide-partially-staged to avoid git stash/restore issues with bind-mounted files in Docker.

actions.action: git diff --name-only --cached --diff-filter=d | grep '.php$' | grep -v '^docker/' | grep -v '^\.php-cs-fixer' | grep -v '^rector\.php$' | xargs -r ./docker/hooks/php-hooks.sh lint
actions.description: Check PHP syntax on staged files (excludes root config files)

actions.action: git diff --name-only --cached --diff-filter=d | grep '.php$' | grep -v '^docker/' | grep -v '^\.php-cs-fixer' | grep -v '^rector\.php$' | xargs -r ./docker/hooks/php-hooks.sh fix
actions.description: Fix PHP coding style on staged files (excludes root config files)
Verify dependencies are installed (auto-install if missing)

Run quality checks (type-based, branch-aware): Fast checks on feature branches (~1-3 min), comprehensive checks on develop/master (~5-15 min). Change detection ensures only relevant tools run. See docker/hooks/pre-push-quality.sh for details.

actions.action: CHANGED=$(git diff-tree -r --name-only --no-commit-id ORIG_HEAD HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(composer\.json|package\.json)$'); if [ -n "$CHANGED" ]; then echo ''; echo -e '\033[0;33m⚠️  Dependencies changed! Run:\033[0m'; echo ''; for f in $CHANGED; do case $f in composer.json) echo -e '   \033[0;36mmake composer-install\033[0m  (or -install-local for IDE code completion)';; package.json) echo -e '   \033[0;36mmake pnpm-install\033[0m      (or -install-local for IDE code completion)';; esac; done; echo ''; fi
actions.description: Warn if dependency files changed after merge/pull
